disclaimer: Demonstration fixture only. This synthetic work item exercises two governance mechanisms with fake references: (1) architecture-change routing — work pauses in ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_REQUEST and resumes through acr_resolved under an approved demo ACR (ACR-901); (2) historical merged-record reconciliation — its ledger intentionally reproduces the same three defect classes as the real CAD-PARITY-011 record (merge performed under an unauthorized role, merge timestamp preceding the recorded approval, no approved decision at or before the merge) and is reconciled by a DECIDED demo reconciliation (governance/reconciliations/SAMPLE-002.json). It makes no claim about real work.
title: Demo: ACR routing and historical merged-record reconciliation fixture
objective: Provide the reproducible, always-green example of the two ARCH-WF-002 mechanisms: an implementation that legally pauses for an architecture change, resumes under an approved ACR, and later carries a historical merged-record defect reconciled by an Architect decision without modifying the immutable ledger.
acceptance_criteria: The record legally enters ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_REQUEST and resumes through acr_resolved citing ACR-901, which was approved before the resume.

The record carries the three reconcilable defect classes in its historical ledger (unauthorized merge role, merge timestamp preceding the recorded approval, no approved decision at or before the merge).
The DECIDED demo reconciliation waives exactly those three violations; the validator reports them as [RECONCILED] rather than silently passing.
No other rule is waived: the record's non-reconcilable rules all hold.
non_goals: Any claim about real work or real authorization.
Any use of the demo ACR outside the demo id range.
risk_assumptions: The demo reconciliation mirrors the real CAD-PARITY-011 defect shape so the waiver mechanics are exercised identically.
evidence_requirements: One qualifying revision-bound evidence item backing the demo reconciliation decision.
